# Spiritual Translation of Kephalaia ¶7

Divine Wisdom proce eding from the Lord impl ants the full ness of essential goods and tru ths into the interior person — the regenerate will and understanding — whom the Lord has freed from falsities, pur ged of evils, sustained through contin ual influx of good and truth, and set apart from what is merely natural into genuine spiritual life.

---

** Translator 's note :** " Five signs" res ists a single precise correspondence . * Five * in Swedenborg sign ifies what is stored inter iorly — * remains * or *remnants* — the hidden goods and truths the Lord preserv es in the interior person from inf ancy on ward, which become the seed - ground of all regener ation. * Signs * are confirm ations or living attest ations of spiritual reality within the person . Together , " five signs put in the new man" reads as: the essential constellation of interior goods and truths that constitute the regener ate person as a vessel capable of receiving the Lord's life . The fo urfold action — *purified, cleansed, supported, chosen * — unf olds the progressive stages of regener ation: removal of falsity from the understanding , removal of evil from the will, sustaining infl ux during tem ptation- comb ats , and final separation of the spiritual person from the natural, so that the interior may rule .
